plan: In a single-round sealed bid auction with a private value of $24, the optimal strategy is to bid strategically. Since the value is randomly drawn and this is a one-time game, I'll aim to bid slightly below my true value to maximize potential profit. A bid around $22-$23 provides a buffer while still giving a good chance of winning. This approach balances the risk of overbidding and the opportunity to secure the item at a price below my true valuation.
